tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Experienced in requirements analysis, agile teamwork, and stakeholder collaboration. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: ABSL SAP CX Entwickler (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Sybit GmbH's reputation for delivering sophisticated digital transformation projects and tailored SAP CX solutions makes this an exciting opportunity. Bringing over 5 years of enterprise SAP Commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I design robust technical concepts and develop scalable web applications within agile teams.

bullets.label: Solution Design & Analysis
bullets.text: Analysed complex client requirements, mapped business processes, and translated them into robust technical concepts and SAP Commerce solutions in close dialogue with stakeholders.

bullets.label: System Integration
bullets.text: Engineered seamless data flows and API integrations between SAP ERP, PIM, MDM, and e-commerce platforms, ensuring high system stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Quality
bullets.text: Contributed to architectural decisions, executed release builds, and maintained strict quality standards across agile delivery cycles.

bullets.label: Client & Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with international business and technical teams during requirements engineering, implementation, and user acceptance testing.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 and am available to start on 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my expertise supports your projects.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als ABSL SAP CX Entwickler (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Sybit steht für erstklassige Digitalisierungsprojekte und anspruchsvolle SAP CX-Lösungen in agilen Teams. Mit über fünf Jahren fundierter Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung von Enterprise-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefgehende Expertise in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Webanwendungen mit.

bullets.label: Anforderungsanalyse & Konzepte
bullets.text: Ich analysiere Kundenanforderungen präzise, konzipiere passgenaue Lösungen und erstelle technische Konzepte für anspruchsvolle Systemumgebungen im direkten Dialog mit den Beteiligten.

bullets.label: Systemintegration & Schnittstellen
bullets.text: Ich erarbeite und realisiere Lösungskonzepte für die nahtlose Anbindung an SAP- und Drittsysteme, um reibungslose Datenflüsse und performante Architekturen sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Agile Entwicklung & Qualität
bullets.text: Als aktiver Teil agiler Projektteams bin ich für die Software-Auslieferung mitverantwortlich und achte konsequent auf die Einhaltung hoher Qualitätsstandards.

bullets.label: Kundenorientierung & Teamarbeit
bullets.text: Ich bringe starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit, arbeite eigenverantwortlich und schätze den direkten Kundenkontakt in anspruchsvollen Digitalisierungsprojekten.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einem regulären Kündigungsverhältnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 für Sie tätig sein kann. Über ein persönliches Gespräch freue ich mich sehr.

tailoring.why_company: Sybit GmbH delivers innovative digital transformation and sophisticated SAP CX solutions for enterprise clients. I want to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise, strong technical design skills, and passion for collaborative agile delivery to help your teams build exceptional, integrated web applications.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce experience, strong technical design skills, and a proven track record in agile integration projects to Sybit GmbH.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of experience in SAP Commerce architecture, integrations, and agile delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the ABSL SAP CX Entwickler role at Sybit. My notice period ends Dec 15, 2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Bewerbung als ABSL SAP CX Entwickler (m/w/d) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application and CV for the ABSL SAP CX Entwickler (m/w/d) position at Sybit GmbH.

With over 5 years of professional experience building and integrating large-scale enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in technical design, system integration, and agile delivery.

I possess a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026 following my notice period.

I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
